name: Epidémie
summary:
Humans are suffering from horrible itching! But who is responsible for this cosmic scratching?
That's what you'll have to find out by visiting four completely crazy planets, where you'll find lots of clues.
Epidemic is a colorful, humorous adventure game in French with animation!
All these reasons make it a game unlike any other, completely revamping the genre.
Hours of fun await you and your friends. But beware of the virus! It's contagious!
